The main takeaway from our work is that

the identification of the molecular defect in a HHT patient is essential to establish an accurate diagnosis, to provide genetic counseling to the family members, and to establish the appropriate treatment.
mutations in ENG and ACVRL1 genes should be screened in patients with HHT, and the identification of new pathogenic variants will help to understand the pathogenesis of this rare disorder.
